summary_en: The study tests HMBD-501, a HER3-targeted antibody-drug conjugate, in adults with advanced or relapsed HER3-expressing solid tumors, including melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer, and breast cancer. It is given as an intravenous injection once every 3 weeks, and higher doses are tested in successive cohorts during the dose-escalation part. The study measures safety and tolerability in the dose-escalation phase and preliminary efficacy in the dose-expansion phase; it is a Phase 1/2 trial.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa HMBD-501, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco dirigido a HER3, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o recidivantes que expresan HER3, incluidos melanoma, cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas y cáncer de mama. Se administra como inyección intravenosa una vez cada 3 semanas, y en cohortes sucesivas se prueban dosis más altas durante la fase de escalado de dosis. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad en la fase de escalado de dosis y la eficacia preliminar en la fase de expansión; es un ensayo de fase 1/2.
who_for: Advanced HER3-positive melanoma, EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, or breast cancer.
Disease that has relapsed or is refractory to standard therapy, or for which standard therapy is not an option.
Willing to have a fresh tumor biopsy for HER3 testing if no HER3 report is available.
not_for: Recent anti-tumor drug, investigational drug, or major surgery within the stated time windows.
Prior HER3-targeted ADC, or exatecan-type ADC, as last line of therapy.
Prior topoisomerase I inhibitor as last line of therapy.
History of non-infectious drug-induced pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease.
Known HIV, hepatitis B, or hepatitis C infection, or symptomatic or uncontrolled brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.
